pages.title: Physics
pages.text: Press $(thing)Q$() or $(thing)V$(): fastest at launch, then slowed by air drag.$(li)Launch speed 10 blocks/tick$(li)Drag 0.94 per tick$(li)Gravity 0.04 blocks/tick^2$(br2)A flat throw lands about 82 blocks away; 2 degrees up reaches about 124.

pages.title: Damage
pages.text: Damage scales with the actual speed at the moment of impact: about 6.5 at full speed, around 12 point blank, capped at 48.$(br2)Falling at the end of the arc adds vertical speed back, so lobbed hits hurt more.

pages.title: Sticking & pickup
pages.text: The coin sticks where it hits, like an arrow. After 0.5s the owner can pick it up by walking within 1.5 blocks.$(br2)A normal coin burns up past 130 blocks of range and lives at most 120 seconds.
